name: Easy Pressure Cooker Hoisin Beef Short Ribs with Asian Chopped Salad

instructions.primary_message: Pat the short ribs dry with paper towels. Arrange in a 6-quart pressure cooker insert, doing your best to fit them in a single layer.
Wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl along with broth, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, chili-garlic sauce, and garlic. Whisk to combine, then pour over the ribs in the pressure cooker.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root
1 cup chicken or vegetable broth
½ cup hoisin sauce
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
1 tbsp minced garlic

instructions.primary_message: Lock lid and set to pressure cook on HIGH for 35 minutes. Once done, allow the pressure to release naturally for 15 minutes, then carefully release any remaining pressure and remove the lid.
When the ribs are done, transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve sauce in the insert for the next step.)

Place water and cornstarch in a small bowl, then whisk to combine. Set the pressure cooker to sauté on HIGH, then add the cornstarch slurry and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, place the contents of the salad kit (including toppings and dressing) in a large bowl. Toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (24.2 oz) pkg Asian chopped salad kit

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide ribs and salad between plates. Spoon sauce over ribs and enjoy!
